description: This source file defines an Android Activity named ProcessText, which handles receiving text data via an intent, displaying it for editing, and returning the modified text back via the intent. It interacts with Android UI components such as EditText and Button, and uses system intent extras related to text processing.

classes.name: ProcessText
classes.description: An Android Activity that processes incoming text, allows user edits, and sends back the result.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, retrieves input text, sets up UI components, and configures the finish button callback.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Overrides the default finish method to include updating the intent with the modified text before closing the activity.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Overrides menu creation to prevent menu from appearing, returning false.
